news.title: Butler University Alumni Association Welcomes New Board Members
news.summary_en: The Butler University Alumni Association (BUAA) recently welcomed seven new members to its Board of Directors. The new members began a four-year term in June and will attend their first quarterly BUAA Board meeting later this month. The BUAA, in partnership with the Office of Butler Community Engagement, serves as a champion of alumni engagement…
news.author: jennifer gunnels

news.title: Chasing the Checkered Flag: Alex Corby’s Path to the Indy 500
news.summary_en: Alex Corby didn’t set out to be part of an Indy 500–winning team. In fact, when he first started thinking about college, he wasn’t even sure he’d stay in Indiana. Growing up traveling the country as a competitive mountain biker, he assumed he would head out of state. But one visit to Butler University changed…
news.author: Maddie Koss '17
